value.summary: This pull request bumps two vendored submodules to upstream main and adapts the codebase to two breaking changes: the split of OpenHuman into a virtual workspace (requiring path repointing and module rename) and TinyHivemind's ADR 0014 (reversing the one-turn-per-step invariant into rounds with multi-speaker turns). The diff is large but mechanical on the OpenHuman side and carefully structured on the hivemind side, with a round-bounded pinboard fix, updated test fixtures, and documentation rewritten to match the changes. The PR description is thorough, includes rationale, test results, and acknowledged follow-up items. I see no problems introduced by this change that would block merging.
